fields.label: Voxel Size
fields.description: Size of the voxel in object space used for volume evaluation. Lower values preserve finer details.

fields.label: Adaptivity
fields.description: Reduces the final face count by simplifying geometry where detail is not needed, generating triangles. A value greater than 0 disables Fix Poles.

fields.label: Fix Poles
fields.description: Produces fewer poles and a better topology flow

fields.label: Volume
fields.description: Projects the mesh to preserve the volume and details of the original mesh
fields.heading: Preserve

fields.label: Attributes
fields.description: Transfer all attributes to the new mesh
